paragraphs: Salesforce, Inc. is an American enterprise software company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It is best known for customer relationship management software and related applications, which the corporation delivers through a software as a service subscription business model. It also provides software for sales, customer service, marketing automation, e-commerce, data analytics, artificial intelligence, agentic AI, and application development.

Founded by former Oracle executive Marc Benioff in March 1999, Salesforce experienced rapid growth in the sector in which it competed, debuting its initial public offering in 2004. Its major acquisitions included Tableau and Slack. As of March 2026, Salesforce has a market capitalization of approximately US$186 billion. For fiscal year 2026 (ending January 31, 2026), the company reported record annual revenue of $41.5 billion. The company is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average (since 2020) and the S&P 500.
description.title: Salesforce

people.name: Marc Benioff
people.title: Chair of the Board, Chief Executive Officer and co-Founder
people.bio: Benioff co-founded Salesforce in 1999 and has served as Chief Executive Officer since 2001. He also serves as Chair of the Salesforce Foundation and on the World Economic Forum Board of Trustees.
people.quote: Marc Benioff is Chair of the Board, Chief Executive Officer and co-Founder of Salesforce and a pioneer of cloud computing.

people.name: Parker Harris
people.title: Director, Chief Technology Officer, Slack and co-Founder
people.bio: Harris co-founded Salesforce in February 1999 and has served in senior technical positions since inception, including as Salesforce's Chief Technology Officer from September 2016 to January 2024. He has been a director since August 2018 and Chief Technology Officer of Slack since January 2024.
people.quote: Parker Harris has served as a Director since August 2018 and as Chief Technology Officer of Slack since January 2024.

people.name: Miguel Milano
people.title: President and Chief Revenue Officer
people.bio: Milano has served as President and Chief Revenue Officer since August 2023 after serving as Co-Owner and Chief Revenue Officer at Celonis from April 2020 to July 2023. He previously held international sales leadership roles at Salesforce from 2011 to 2020.
people.quote: Miguel Milano has served as our President and Chief Revenue Officer since August 2023.

people.name: Sabastian Niles
people.title: President and Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Niles has served as President and Chief Legal Officer since July 2023 and Corporate Secretary since December 2024. Previously, he was a partner at Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, where he practiced law from September 2006 to July 2023.
people.quote: Sabastian Niles has served as our President and Chief Legal Officer since July 2023 and Corporate Secretary since December 2024.

people.name: Sundeep Reddy
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Reddy has served as Chief Accounting Officer since September 2021. Previously, he held corporate finance leadership roles at McKesson from 2013 to 2021, including Senior Vice President, Controller and Chief Accounting Officer.
people.quote: Sundeep Reddy has served as our Chief Accounting Officer since September 2021.

people.name: Srinivas Tallapragada
people.title: President and Chief Engineering Officer and Customer Success Officer
people.bio: Tallapragada has served as President and Chief Engineering & Customer Success Officer since February 2025, following several Salesforce engineering and technology leadership roles beginning in May 2012. Previously, he served as Senior Vice President at Oracle and SAP Labs.
people.quote: Srinivas Tallapragada has served as our President and Chief Engineering & Customer Success Officer since February 2025.

people.name: Robin Washington
people.title: Director, President and Chief Operating and Financial Officer
people.bio: Washington has served as a Salesforce director since September 2013 and President and Chief Operating and Financial Officer since March 2025. Previously, she served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Gilead Sciences and Chief Financial Officer of Hyperion Solutions.
people.quote: Robin Washington has served as a Director since September 2013, including as Lead Independent Director from 2022 to 2025
